task.title: Transferring a claim — Claim converted to MPS

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the address in both ITCs is the client’s address:
Select the Name and Address Change/Transfer (M159) transaction to change the address and transfer the claim to the appropriate ITC as follows:

ul.li: Confirm that the client’s name is correct. If not, enter the correct information.

New SCC: Select the appropriate option:
Atlantic: Select 1121 .
Ontario: Select 3515 .
Quebec: Select 2371 .
Western Canada and Territories: Select 4812 .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Name and Address Change/Transfer (M159) transaction to transfer the claim to the appropriate ITC as follows:

ul.li: Confirm that the client’s name is correct. If not, enter the correct information.

New SCC: Select the appropriate option:
Atlantic: Select 1121 .
Ontario: Select 3515 .
Quebec: Select 2371 .
Western Canada and Territories: Select 4812 .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select the investigation type as displayed in NIIS.
Message: Select 27 - An overpayment resulted due to an incorrect calculation .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 54 - Third party fraud .
Remarks line 1: Type “Victim of 3rd party fraud. Convert claim to MPS once transfer is ”
Remarks line 2: Type “finalized. Remove w/cs [XXXX] to [XXXX] paid to the third party.”
Remarks line 3: Type “Adjust client’s tax file.”
Remarks line 4: Type “Issue payments for w/cs [XXXX] to [XXXX] (include no coding or, if necessary, the required coding).”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity file number] — EI claim transferred due to a fraudulent address.”

Details: Do the following:
Type: “The investigator confirmed the client’s address on [date]. The client’s address is: [client’s address].”
Document the decision and rationale according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Create a ROD on the fraudulent EI application as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity file number] — Fraudulent EI application.”

Details: Enter the following information:
Relevant facts: Type “An EI application was filed by a third party on [date] using the client’s identity.”
Decision/Justification: Type “This application was not filed by the client and must not be included in an access to information request.”

step.cmd: To delete the fraudulent application, create a REM WI as follows:

ul.li: Due date: Enter the next working day.
Destination — SCC: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.

End user: Select Specific user:
Enter the name of the team leader or the designated person and select Find user .

step.cmd: In NIIS, on the Decision tab of the Report of Investigation (IC70) , close the case as follows:

ul.li:
Disentitlement: Select No .
Reason: In the text box type “Client’s address and banking information have been corrected and the claim transferred to the appropriate ITC.”
Overpayment: Do not check the box.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete the registration number as follows:

ul.li: Claim Allowed: Select NCA - No changes to the claim .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the CR Integrity WI.
